# P3-A — Lock Screen privacy and disclosure (proof)

**Status:** `P3-A EVIDENCE — NOT FROZEN`. Evidence: board 10 (all words generated by `model.project()`), settings
boards 07 / 08, checks C-PRIV-1…5.

## 1. The frozen rules realized (I-08N-01 D14–D17, §10)

- Four levels: **L0 Minimal · L1 Generic · L2 Bounded Context · L3 Content Preview**. The codes are never shown.
- Defaults (D15, verbatim in `DISCLOSURE_DEFAULTS`): Personal / Proactive QANDEEL **L1**; Shared **L2**; Public
  interactions **L2**; Public discovery **L1**; **Introductions L0**; reminders **L2**; System / account **L2**; critical
  security **L2**.
- **L3 is never a default** (C-PRIV-2). Richer disclosure needs the user's explicit choice, per category (D16).
- The user's choice is a **ceiling**: QANDEEL may render less, never more (D17; C-PRIV-3 tries 36 combinations). An
  event may also carry a content cap (`safeMax`): an Introduction never goes beyond L1 even if the user allows more.
- **Critical importance does not raise disclosure** (C-PRIV-4): a new sign-in is L2 even though it is Class 1.
- **Bounded safe projection:** the renderer gets one event's words for one level. No preview can combine Worlds
  (C-PRIV-5).

## 2. What each level says (Arabic, from board 10)

| Level | Personal / QANDEEL | Shared | Introductions | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L0 | «إشعار جديد» | «إشعار جديد» | **«إشعار جديد»** ← default | «إشعار جديد» |
| L1 | «رسالة من قنديل» ← default | «نشاط جديد في العالم المشترك» | «تحديث في التعارف» (user's choice only) | «تنبيه أمان» |
| L2 | «قنديل» · «بخصوص عرض الخميس» | «رحلة الصيف» · «سارة ردّت عليك» ← default | capped at L1 | «الأمان» · «تسجيل دخول جديد على حسابك» ← default |
| L3 | the QANDEEL message itself | «رحلة الصيف» · «سارة: تمام، هحجز التذاكر النهارده» | capped at L1 | capped at L2 |

At its default **L0**, an Introductions notification reveals neither that it is about Introductions nor any person
(C-PRIV-1; D15's special rule; D26).

## 3. Human words in settings (task §10)

«معاينات شاشة القفل» / "Lock Screen previews", one row per subject, each opening a chooser of four ceilings:

| Level | Arabic | English | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| L0 | «خاصة جدًا» | Very private | Product Owner direction / proof |
| L1 | «تنبيه عام» | General | **open craft** — the direction gave three words for four levels |
| L2 | «إظهار السياق» | Show context | direction / proof |
| L3 | «إظهار المعاينة» | Show preview | direction / proof |

Each option says what it shows in one line; the sheet says «هذا حدّ أقصى: قد يُظهر قنديل تفاصيل أقل.»

## 4. Native outside, QANDEEL inside (P3-C / P3-Q)

The outer card is the platform's: board 10 draws grey **schematic** stand-ins for an iOS-like and an Android-like
card and claims no pixel accuracy; the app icon is a placeholder. QANDEEL owns only the words. The platform can still
hide more — iOS "Show Previews" (always / when unlocked / never), Android per-channel Lock Screen visibility, where the
user "always has ultimate control". QANDEEL never relies on the device to hide what its own level must not say.
